description: Create a downtime to mute monitors by scope, monitor ID, or monitor tags

end.description: End time as Unix epoch seconds (omit for indefinite). Example: 1740003600

message.description: Notification message. Example: Scheduled maintenance window

monitorId.description: Specific monitor ID to mute. Example: 12345678

monitorTags.description: Mute monitors matching these tags. Example: ["service:api"]

notifyEndStates.description: States to notify on end. Example: ["alert", "warn"]

scope.description: Downtime scope. Example: env:prod or host:web-01 or * (all)

start.description: Start time as Unix epoch seconds. Example: 1740000000

timezone.description: IANA timezone. Example: UTC or America/New_York

name: create-downtime
